verdict.rationale: The evidence never documents user identification, SSO, or tying feedback submissions to existing accounts. The featurebase-js SDK covers booting the chat messenger, and the changelog feature segments by user attributes, but neither shows logged-in users being identified when they submit feedback. Those are adjacent features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can identify logged-in users when they submit feedback so it ties to their existing account
